item.title: Manhunt Launched After Three Inmates Escape Georgia Jail
item.description: The breakout was discovered during a routine security check, according to the DeKalb County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: DOJ Includes Clip Of Disputed Epstein Jail Cell Footage In Files — But Quickly Kills Link
item.description: Several prominent social-media influencers on Monday circulated a video — claiming it came from the Department of Justice — that shows Jeffrey Epstein attempting to take his own life inside a jail cell.

item.title: Bill Simmons Fuels Taylor Swift Baby Buzz With On-Air Remark
item.description: The remark immediately sparked online buzz, with fans questioning whether Simmons was speculating about the couple’s future or suggesting something more immediate.

item.title: Brown University Under Fed’s Microscope Following Fatal Shooting
item.description: The Department of Education (ED) on Monday opened a review into Brown University following the Dec. 13 fatal shooting on campus.

item.title: Trump Slams DOJ Over Epstein Photo Release
item.description: “No, I don’t like the pictures of Bill Clinton being shown."

item.title: Brother Of Trans Woman Who Murdered Parents Blames ‘Reckless’ Prescription Of Sex Change Hormones
item.description: A Utah woman received two consecutive sentences of 25 years to life in prison Friday after pleading guilty to murdering her parents, as her brother blamed what he called the reckless prescription of sex-change hormones.

item.title: Feds’ Case Against Ex-Democrat Aide Accused Of Working With China Hits Roadblock
item.description: A federal judge declared a mistrial Monday in the corruption case against a former top aide to Democratic New York Gov. Kathy Hochul and her predecessor, former Democratic Gov. Andrew Cuomo, after jurors said they were hopelessly deadlocked and could not reach a verdict.

item.title: Grad Instructor Who Flunked Student Over Bible Reference Dismissed From Job
item.description: A graduate teaching assistant who issued a failing grade to a University of Oklahoma (OU) student for referencing the Bible in a psychology essay will no longer have instructional duties at the university, officials said Monday.

item.title: Ohio Cops Stunned as Kids as Young as 8 Lead Car Chase After Learning on YouTube
item.description: Authorities said the three juveniles, ages 8, 11, and 12, later admitted they had taught themselves how to steal cars by watching YouTube videos.

item.title: Watch Hunter Biden Claim With Straight Face That Laptop From Hell Never Existed
item.description: Hunter Biden told podcaster Shawn Ryan in an interview that aired Monday that former Republican Mayor Rudy Giuliani of New York City “concocted” the laptop that was the subject of an October 2020 New York Post report.
